keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «플라스틱이 미세플라스틱이 되어 해양 생물을 위협한다(문제)» 와 «처음부터 플라스틱이 바다에 가지 않게 막는 것(해결책)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (microplastics threaten marine life) and the solution (stop plastic from reaching the ocean in the first place). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Microplastics are a growing threat to marine life
Broken bottles and bags, and fibers from synthetic clothes
Stop plastic from reaching the ocean

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Plastic in the ocean breaks into tiny
called microplastics. Some are broken down from bottles by sunlight and
, and others are fibers from washing synthetic
. Sea animals often mistake them for
, and the particles move up the food
. The best solution is to stop plastic from reaching the ocean.

words: which pose a growing threat to marine life
living in or connected with the sea
Microplastics are usually defined as pieces smaller than five millimeters.
fibers released when synthetic clothes are washed
made by people, not found in nature
Eating plastic can harm their digestion and growth
the way the body breaks down food
These particles can also move up the food chain
made to be used once and then thrown away

qs.q: Why are microplastics almost impossible to remove from the water?
qs.qko: 왜 미세플라스틱은 물에서 없애기가 거의 불가능할까요?
opts: because they sink to the deepest trench
because they melt in salt water
evs: Some come from larger items, such as bottles and bags, that are broken down by sunlight and waves.
Scientists have found microplastics in seafood and in sea salt, raising questions about effects on human health.
Because they are so small, microplastics are almost impossible to remove from the water.
Every year, millions of tons of plastic waste enter the ocean.
why: 미세플라스틱이 너무 작기 때문에 물에서 없애기가 거의 불가능하다고 했어요.
The text says that because they are so small, microplastics are almost impossible to remove.

qs.q: What does "move up the food chain" mean in the text?
qs.qko: 글에서 «move up the food chain» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: pass from small animals into the larger animals that eat them
float up from the sea floor to the surface
get cleaned out of the water by plankton
evs: These particles can also move up the food chain, as small animals are eaten by larger ones.
Fish, shellfish, and even plankton often mistake them for food.
Microplastics are usually defined as pieces smaller than five millimeters.
Using less single-use plastic and improving waste management are important first steps.
why: 같은 문장에서 작은 동물이 큰 동물에게 먹히면서 입자가 옮겨 간다고 설명해요.
The same sentence explains it: small animals are eaten by larger ones, so the particles pass upward.

qs.q: Why is stopping plastic from reaching the ocean the most effective solution?
qs.qko: 왜 플라스틱이 바다에 가지 않게 막는 것이 가장 효과적인 해결책일까요?
opts: Cleaning up microplastics later is extremely difficult.
Plastic disappears quickly once it is in the ocean.
Fish are not harmed when they eat plastic.
evs: Since cleaning them up is so difficult, the most effective solution is to stop plastic from reaching the ocean in the first place.
Much of this plastic does not disappear but breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics, which pose a growing threat to marine life.
Because they are so small, microplastics are almost impossible to remove from the water.
Others are tiny from the start, including fibers released when synthetic clothes are washed.
why: 미세플라스틱은 너무 작아 치우기가 거의 불가능하므로, 처음부터 바다에 가지 않게 막는 것이 가장 좋다고 했어요.
Microplastics are almost impossible to remove, so the best solution is to keep plastic out of the ocean in the first place.

ends: Find out how scientists track plastic floating across the ocean.
과학자들이 바다를 떠다니는 플라스틱을 어떻게 추적하는지 알아봐요.
Learn which everyday items can replace single-use plastic.
일회용 플라스틱을 대신할 생활 물건을 알아봐요.

write.src: “We should <u>carry our own water bottles</u> so that <u>less plastic reaches the ocean</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «우리가 할 일 + 그러면 생기는 좋은 결과» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and the good result in English.

chips.a: bring cloth bags to the store
chips.label: bags

chips.b: fewer straws end up on beaches
chips.label: straws

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가/무엇이 + 어떻게 된다» 를 넣어 결과를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: so that the beach stays clean)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who or what + what happens to make the result clear. (e.g. so that the beach stays clean)
